# IntegrateAI

> IntegrateAI gives specialty coffee roasters one mission control. It brings sales, finance, roasting, delivery and customer data from the tools a roaster already uses into one screen, checks it every night, and tells the owner each weekday morning what changed and what needs attention.

IntegrateAI is a UK company. It is in beta and sells to specialty coffee roasters. All names and figures shown on the website are invented samples.

## What it does

- One screen: sales, money, roasting, delivery and emails joined up in one place, from tools such as Xero, Shopify, Skio, Stripe, Cropster, Royal Mail, DPD, Klaviyo and Basecamp.
- An AI team: six AI advisers covering finance, revenue, operations, marketing, technology and the overall business.
- A morning brief: every weekday morning, a short brief in Slack and on the owner's mission control.
- Questions answered: owners can ask a question in Slack or on their mission control and usually get an answer in about a minute.
- Nightly checks: late invoices, quiet accounts and subscriptions at risk.
